summary:
丹納赫上一季 EPS 小幅超預期2%，營收6.84億美元，基本面穩中待回升。
• EPS 2.23 美元，較預估2.19超出1.99%。
• 營收6.84億美元（B級），規模穩定。
• 獲利達標反映高毛利商業模式韌性。
• 本益比35，市場給予品質溢價。
ai_view:
訊號中性偏穩：EPS 小幅超預期，顯示丹納赫高毛利平台的獲利韌性，但本季營收年增率未揭露，成長動能不明朗。短期股價靠品質溢價與防禦屬性支撐，中期需確認生命科學循環是否真正回升。追蹤指標：核心營收成長、生物製藥訂單、自由現金流轉換率與資本配置效率。35倍本益比要求持續交付，估值容錯空間有限。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，難判斷成長趨勢。；生命科學需求復甦節奏緩慢。；高估值對任何成長失速較敏感。

summary_en:
Danaher edged past EPS by 2% with $6.84B revenue, a stable base awaiting recovery.
• EPS of $2.23 beat the $2.19 estimate by 1.99%.
• Revenue of $6.84B held at a stable scale.
• Meeting profit targets reflects a resilient high-margin model.
• P/E of 35 reflects a quality premium from the market.

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-stable: a small EPS beat shows the resilience of Danaher's high-margin platform, but undisclosed revenue YoY leaves growth momentum unclear. Near-term the stock leans on its quality premium and defensive profile; mid-term hinges on confirming a genuine life-science cyclical upturn. Track core revenue growth, biopharma orders, free-cash-flow conversion, and capital allocation. A 35x P/E demands consistent delivery with limited margin for error.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, clouding the growth trend.; Life-science demand recovery is slow-paced.; Elevated valuation is sensitive to any growth stall.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出1.99%，小幅優於市場共識。
